items.question: Who should Voss-Lindqvist direct questions about the change of control to?
items.answer:
The documents indicate that Voss-Lindqvist should direct questions about the change of control to Harrowgate Systems Inc.'s General Counsel. This is stated in the Change of Control notice, which says, "Please direct any questions to our General Counsel, Thomas Reyes" [1].

Additionally, the Master Services Agreement specifies that notices should be addressed to the General Counsel of the receiving party. This is outlined in Clause 22.1 of the Harrowgate MSA, which states, "Any notice under this Agreement shall be in writing and addressed to the General Counsel of the receiving party at the address set out in Schedule 4" [6].

Therefore, based on the documents, Voss-Lindqvist should direct questions about the change of control to Harrowgate Systems Inc.'s General Counsel.
